summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Horse Racing Betting Analyzer with LIVE Racing API integration. All backend APIs (17/17) pass and all frontend pages load correctly with full functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/ - Returns running status
GET /api/scraper/status - Shows The Racing API as connected
GET /api/tracks - Returns UK and US approved tracks
GET /api/bankroll - Returns bankroll settings (current, stop-loss, cushion, etc.)
PUT /api/bankroll - Updates bankroll settings successfully
GET /api/racecards/today - Returns LIVE racecards with courses and races from The Racing API
POST /api/analyze with race_id - Analyzes live race with 8-criteria scoring
POST /api/analyze with track/race_number - Fallback mock data analysis works
GET /api/bets - Returns bet history
POST /api/bets - Places new bet with bankroll deduction
POST /api/bets/{bet_id}/settle - Settles bet as WIN with profit calculation
POST /api/bets/{bet_id}/settle - Settles bet as LOSS with loss tracking
GET /api/statistics - Returns betting statistics with by-score breakdown
Edge case: Invalid race_id returns 404
Edge case: Non-existent bet settle returns 404
Edge case: Excessive stake rejected (max 3% rule)
Edge case: Double settlement prevented
Frontend: Dashboard loads with bankroll widget, quick stats, recent bets
Frontend: Race Analysis shows LIVE badge with data from The Racing API
Frontend: 5 courses displayed (Ayr, Ffos Las, Lingfield, Newcastle, Limerick)
Frontend: Clicking course shows races with off times, types, classes
Frontend: Analyze button triggers 8-criteria scoring algorithm
Frontend: Recommendations show WIN, PLACE, TRIFECTA, SAFETY bets with criteria breakdown
Frontend: Place Bet button opens confirm dialog with horse, type, odds, stake, potential profit
Frontend: Confirm Bet successfully places bet with toast notification
Frontend: Bet History shows all bets with Pending/Won/Lost status
Frontend: Settle dialog with Lost/Won buttons works correctly
Frontend: Statistics page shows charts and performance by score level
Frontend: Settings page shows bankroll settings and discipline rules
test_credentials: No authentication required - app runs in no-auth mode
seed_data_creation: Test bets created with TEST_ prefix for backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. The Racing API integration is LIVE and connected. Rate limiting (429) is handled with 2-minute cache. Odds shown are 'Estimated' since free API plan doesn't provide bookmaker odds. 8-criteria scoring algorithm produces recommendations for WIN, PLACE, TRIFECTA, and SAFETY bets.

api_notes.odds_note: Odds are 'Estimated' - free API plan doesn't provide bookmaker odds
